nodes.rationale: FastAPI 0.115.0 and Uvicorn 0.30.6 are pinned for the local service.

nodes.label: PyTorch
nodes.rationale: torch 2.4.1 and torchvision 0.19.1 are pinned.

nodes.label: Ultralytics
nodes.rationale: Ultralytics 8.3.0 is pinned.

nodes.label: Training environment
nodes.rationale: Pins NumPy 1.26.4, Pillow 12.3.0, headless OpenCV 4.10.0.84, torch 2.4.1, and torchvision 0.19.1; this is the documented training environment rather than proof of returned runtime versions.

nodes.label: Journey replay
nodes.rationale: Replay begins after vehicle selection and presents predicted movement alongside chronological visits; the page explicitly distinguishes observations from interpolated geometry.

nodes.label: Source evidence
nodes.rationale: Selecting a timeline visit exposes crop/source-frame evidence with sample tabs; confidence is labeled uncalibrated similarity rather than probability.

nodes.label: Local Leaflet
nodes.rationale: Leaflet 1.9.4 is bundled under BSD-2-Clause with no basemap tile requests; approximate camera points and dashed straight interpolation retain their provenance.

nodes.label: Test frontend
nodes.rationale: A plain HTML/JavaScript client reads frozen predictions from the local FastAPI service, searches RoadEye IDs/tracklets/cameras, selects crops, replays visits, and inspects source frames.

nodes.label: Apache License 2.0
nodes.rationale: The upstream inference components are used under Apache License 2.0; no broader dataset or model redistribution rights are asserted.

nodes.label: FastReID
nodes.rationale: The RoadEye inference adapter derives from revision c9bc3ceb2f7a6438b62fb515ea3df6d1e999e95d; upstream component authorship credits liaoxingyu.

nodes.label: VeRi initialization checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Official v0.1.1/veri_sbs_R50-ibn.pth has SHA-256 57fb9c17d88911ea64390bf5427f43511435e7f88f6eed9dbc969d4b611e53cd and declared VeRi training; weights stay local and upstream benchmark results are not RoadEye accuracy.

nodes.label: RoadEye test console
nodes.rationale: The page provides vehicle search, a default multi-camera filter, map, chronological timeline, and source-evidence panel; its Content Security Policy restricts scripts, styles, and connections to self.

nodes.label: Confidence taxonomy
nodes.rationale: EXTRACTED relationships require explicit source evidence and score 1.0; INFERRED relationships use a fixed confidence rubric; uncertain relationships remain AMBIGUOUS.

nodes.label: Graph health
nodes.rationale: An empty extraction must not overwrite an existing graph; export shrink guards and read-only diagnostics surface missing endpoints, collapsed edges, and self-loops.

nodes.label: CPU offline contract
nodes.rationale: Use Python 3.11, pinned dependencies, deterministic processing, explicit model preparation, provenance, meaningful failure handling, and a CPU/offline rehearsal without hidden startup downloads.

nodes.label: Ground-truth isolation
nodes.rationale: CityFlow identities and evaluator associations must not enter runtime artifacts; raw datasets, weights, crops, databases, and transcription files remain ignored.

nodes.label: Manual transcription gate
nodes.rationale: Review 50 development families, freeze OCR, then review the 200 test families; EasyOCR suggestions cannot be marked reviewed by the agent, and sealed test scoring requires at least 150 verified strings.

nodes.label: Phase workflow
nodes.rationale: Inspect evidence before implementation, execute only approved phases, audit measured outcomes, commit locally at checkpoints, and stop for explicit direction; implementation requires verifiable Astra 6 xhigh configuration.

nodes.label: Causal prefix
nodes.rationale: A tracklet descriptor uses its first three observed crops and becomes available only at the last prefix observation; future crops or endpoints cannot revise earlier decisions.

nodes.label: Quality prefix
nodes.rationale: Accept the first three sufficiently detailed and large crops, at least 0.5 seconds apart within three seconds of track start; quality decisions remain causal, and excluded tracks stay in the broader recall denominator.

nodes.label: Reviewed transcription truth
nodes.rationale: Hash-bound CSV rows marked reviewed are truth; suggested, pending, and unreadable rows are excluded from accuracy denominators. Freeze development-selected preprocessing and all hashes before exposing test families.
nodes.source_location: Indian detector and OCR evaluation boundary

nodes.label: Trained encoder acceptance
nodes.rationale: Accept a strict three-member result ZIP through complete hashes, recomputed epoch selection, provenance review, and local CPU inference; freeze model, config, metadata, acceptance report, and runtime sources before scoring.
nodes.source_location: Accepted trained encoder and S02 result

nodes.label: Training identity split
nodes.rationale: Split complete scoped S01/S03 identities before crop extraction: 2,318 crops from 90 training identities and 582 crops from 23 development identities, with zero identity overlap and S02/S04/S05 excluded.

nodes.label: Independent accuracy claims
nodes.rationale: Report exact denominators, uncertainty, unreadable cases, CPU latency, and frozen-split scope; the 90% plate target is unverified and similarity scores are not probabilities.

nodes.label: URL ingestion
nodes.rationale: Saves supported URLs under raw with author and contributor metadata, then updates the graph after successful ingestion.

nodes.label: Watch mode
nodes.rationale: Debounced code changes trigger AST rebuilds; document, paper, and image changes require a semantic-update notification.

nodes.label: Graph exports
nodes.rationale: Wiki, Neo4j, FalkorDB, SVG, and GraphML exports are opt-in; database exports use MERGE to avoid duplicates.

nodes.label: MCP server
nodes.rationale: A stdio server exposes graph querying, node and neighbor lookup, communities, god nodes, graph statistics, and shortest paths through the resolved graphify interpreter.

nodes.label: Cross-repository graphs
nodes.rationale: Build each repository or subfolder graph separately before merging; origin attributes preserve repository identity and separate output directories prevent clobbering.

nodes.label: CLAUDE integration
nodes.rationale: The installed CLAUDE.md section directs future sessions to consult the graph before codebase questions and rebuild after code changes.

nodes.label: Post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: After commits, changed code receives AST extraction and graph/report regeneration; document and image changes still need a manual semantic update.

nodes.label: Graph traversal
nodes.rationale: BFS answers broad neighborhood questions; DFS traces chains; path and explain provide focused navigation, with NetworkX fallbacks and token budgets.

nodes.label: Work memory
nodes.rationale: Saved answers retain query expansion and useful, dead_end, or corrected outcomes; reflection refreshes lessons, preferred sources, and known dead ends.

nodes.label: Whisper transcription
nodes.rationale: Audio and video become text documents before semantic extraction; domain hints guide Whisper, with a generic prompt for video-only corpora.

nodes.label: Cluster-only
nodes.rationale: The self-contained command reclusters, labels communities, and regenerates graph outputs from the existing graph without extraction sidecars.

nodes.label: graphify
nodes.rationale: Builds a persistent, queryable knowledge graph with community detection, source provenance, and explicit uncertainty.

nodes.label: Deterministic node IDs
nodes.rationale: Full repository-relative path stems and normalized entity names align semantic and AST IDs; verbatim source paths support replacement during incremental merging.
nodes.source_location: Node ID format and source_file RULE

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion
nodes.rationale: Literal substring matching lacks stemming and synonyms, so up to twelve tokens must be selected from the actual graph vocabulary and disclosed before traversal.

nodes.label: Incremental re-extraction
nodes.rationale: Only changed files are re-extracted; build_merge replaces changed sources, prunes genuinely deleted sources, preserves edge direction and hyperedges, and leaves failed semantic files unstamped.

nodes.label: Extraction cache
nodes.rationale: Semantic cache entries are attributed to the exact extraction prompt; failed or omitted semantic files must remain eligible for re-extraction.

nodes.label: Semantic extraction
nodes.rationale: Docs, papers, and images receive semantic extraction through Gemini when configured or through the host agent; independent chunks can run alongside AST extraction.

nodes.label: Structural extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic AST extraction handles code without an LLM or API key; code-only corpora skip semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Graph-first navigation
nodes.rationale: Use graphify query for codebase questions, path or explain for focused relationships, the wiki for broad navigation, and graphify update after code changes.
